title: Commercial Gas Relationship Relief on C&I Termination Security
content:
**§ Termination security: commercial gas relationship relief** - Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts

The termination security's gas relationship relief depends on the Beacon Ridge commercial gas agreement, under Commercial Natural Gas Supply, on the same premise as the terminating C&I contract: an active agreement with 12 or more energy charge lines posted in the twelve months before the handling date gives a relief of 0.15 (15%), an active agreement with 6 up to 11 such lines gives a relief of 0.08 (8%), and any other case gives no relief.

The records read are the commercial gas agreement on that premise, its status, and the energy charge lines on its bill, counted by posted date. A line falls in the twelve months before the handling date when it was posted on or before the handling date and fewer than twelve whole calendar months have passed from its posted date to the handling date.

| Commercial gas agreement on the same premise | Energy charge lines posted on it in the twelve months | Relief |
|---|---|---|
| active | 12 or more | 0.15 |
| active | 6 to 11 | 0.08 |
| active | 5 or fewer | none |
| any status other than active | any number | none |
| no commercial gas agreement on the premise | none | none |

## Points of judgement

- Only the commercial gas agreement on the premise of the terminating C&I contract is read; gas agreements of the same business at other premises are not.
- An active agreement with exactly 12 energy charge lines in the twelve months gives 0.15; with exactly 6, 0.08; with 5, none.
